## 2026-05-30
- Recovered session state with `planning-with-files` catchup and confirmed the target-boundary escape hatch is already modeled as `scope.target_policy: disabled`.
- Re-checked implementation and documentation: default policy is `enforce`, `disabled` bypasses command-runner target/exclusion/argument-boundary checks for authorized false-positive cases, and `{{target}}` templates still require concrete scoped target values.
- Verified focused target-policy/isolation regression with `GOPROXY=https://goproxy.cn,direct go test ./internal/app -run 'ExcludedScopeTarget|DisableCommandTargetPolicy|RejectsTargetTemplateWithoutMatchingScope|OutOfScopeRunCommandURLArgument|DisableRunCommandURLArgumentPolicy|OutOfScopeRunCommandCIDRArgument|DisableRunCommandCIDRArgumentPolicy|OutOfScopeRunCommandChallengeArgument|DisableRunCommandChallengeArgumentPolicy|DisableIsolation|InvalidExecutionIsolation' -v`.

- Continued production hardening with initial container isolation for command-bound tool execution.
- Added failing app tests first for `execution.isolation: container` wrapping an inner command with a fake container engine and for rejecting container isolation without `execution.container.image`.
- Confirmed red state: `container` was rejected as an unsupported isolation mode before implementation.
- Added `ContainerExecutionConfig` under workspace `scope.yaml` execution settings; container mode now requires an image and defaults the engine to `docker`.
- Implemented container command wrapping for `runner: command`: the host resolves only the container engine, mounts the workspace at `/workspace`, sets workdir to `/workspace/attempts/<run-id>/<execution-id>`, injects container-path `OURO_*` env args, appends the configured image, and leaves inner command resolution to the image.
- Tool execution events now record `isolation=container` plus `container_engine` and `container_image` audit fields while preserving the host attempt directory for replay/report references.
